description: Plaid is a financial data API connecting apps to users' bank accounts, covering payments, transactions, identity, and credit underwriting.
access_notes: Developers self-serve create a Dashboard account and immediately get Sandbox/Development API keys (client_id/secret). Production API access requires explicitly requesting approval via the Dashboard before using real bank data.
api_notes: Payments/transfers, transactions, investments, liabilities, identity/KYC, fraud monitoring, and credit/income underwriting endpoints.
main_blocker: Production access requires a separate approval request beyond initial signup.
